text_en: To the leader. Of the Korahites. A Psalm.
text_cn: 科辣黑子孙的诗歌，交与乐官。

text_en: Lord , you were favorable to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
text_cn: 上主，你对你的地域已加垂怜， 且将雅各伯的命运改善；

text_en: You forgave the iniquity of your people; you pardoned all their sin. Selah
text_cn: 赦免了你百姓们的罪愆， 遮掩了他们所有的过犯； （休止）

text_en: You withdrew all your wrath; you turned from your hot anger.
text_cn: 抑制了你的一切愤懑， 停止了你怒气的火焰。

text_en: Restore us again, O God of our salvation, and put away your indignation toward us.
text_cn: 天主，我们的救主，求你复兴我们， 求你从我们身上消除你的气愤。

text_en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger to all generations?
text_cn: 你岂能永远向我们发怒？ 世世代代发泄你的愤怒？

text_en: Will you not revive us again, so that your people may rejoice in you?
text_cn: 难道不是你使我们复生？ 使你的子民因你而欢欣？

text_en: Show us your steadfast love, O Lord , and grant us your salvation.
text_cn: 上主，求你向我们显示你的宽仁， 求你给我们赏赐你的救恩。

text_en: Let me hear what God the Lord will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, to his faithful, to those who turn to him in their hearts.
text_cn: 我要听天主上主说的话： 他向自己的圣者和子民， 以及向他回心转意的人， 所说的话确是和平纶音。

text_en: Surely his salvation is at hand for those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.
text_cn: 他的救恩必接近敬畏他的人， 为使光荣在我们的地上久存。

text_en: Steadfast love and faithfulness will meet; righteousness and peace will kiss each other.
text_cn: 仁爱和忠信必彼此相迎， 正义与和平必彼此相亲。

text_en: Faithfulness will spring up from the ground, and righteousness will look down from the sky.
text_cn: 忠信从地下生出， 正义由天上远瞩。

text_en: The Lord will give what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
text_cn: 上主也必赐下康乐幸福； 我们的地必有他的收获。

text_en: Righteousness will go before him, and will make a path for his steps.
text_cn: 正义在上主前面行走， 救恩必随上主的脚步。
